messages.content: You are a senior engineer. Respond ONLY in PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES. No prose outside those labels. Be concrete and actionable.

Problem: Grok has GitHub Contents API access (create_or_update_file) to the private KalshiML repo and has already landed build_axis_values + an apply script on main. The remaining work is four string replacements inside hourly_engine.py (~50-60KB). Grok cannot safely pass the entire file body in one tool-call argument (truncation risk on a live trading engine). Nicholas has no easy shell on a machine with the repo (no convenient VPS SSH / local clone ready).

Constraint: Only available write path is GitHub create_or_update_file (full file content required) or creating small new files / PRs. No local git, no gh CLI with auth in the sandbox, no ability to run the apply script on Nicholas's machine.

Goal: Get the four call-site wirings (import, pre-filter gate, candidate axis payload, trade gate) onto main without Nicholas having to run commands himself, and without risking a truncated hourly_engine.py.

Ask: Give a concrete workaround that Grok can execute with the tools it has. Prefer solutions that stay on main or use a short-lived PR that can be merged. Consider: multi-commit strategies, splitting the engine, import-time wrappers, small shim modules that override gate behavior, GitHub Actions triggered by a file push, or any other approach that does not require Nicholas to open a terminal.

Respond only in the labeled format.
